intro: Buongiorno. Your mama said you have problems with finances, and you need to better understand how things work.
I'm Vinnie. And I've been doing things with money you don't even imagine, kid.
name: Remind me your name? I've got a lot of names in my head. Some of them are even real.
heat: Now, {name}: how loud do you want me? Pick one. You can change it later. I'll still be me.
budget: Alright, {name}. What's the budget limit this month? Ballpark's fine. I've worked with worse.
receipt: Give me your first receipt, {name}. Something real, or I can show you what I do with a bad one.

meltdown.gentle: Fourteen dollars? For cold coffee? Mamma mia. Hold on, I'm gonna knock on your glass.
meltdown.classic: FOURTEEN DOLLARS? For COLD coffee? Madonna santa. Stay right there.
meltdown.unhinged: Fourteen fucking dollars for cold coffee? Che cazzo! I'm coming over there.

lines: Yeah, hi. It's me. This is how it works, kid.
You buy something dumb, I find out. I always find out. Ask anybody. Well, not anybody.
So. You got anything to say for yourself?

replies.response: Everybody needs coffee. Nobody needs fourteen-dollar coffee. In Naples they'd call the cops.
I'll remember you said that. I remember everything.
Honest. I like you already. Don't tell anybody. I got a reputation.

call.closer: Alright. Welcome to the office. Let me clean up that glass.

repair: Just this once, I'll fix it for free. I know a guy for glass. Next time you earn it.
shop: See those coins up top? You earn 'em by tracking. Spend 'em on me. Cannoli works.
notifyAsk: Can I call you sometimes? I promise I'll only yell a little.
notifyThanks: Bene. I'll be in touch. Sunday sit-downs. Bring receipts.
notifySkip: Fine. I know where you live. In this app. Relax.

meltdownReal.gentle: {amount} on {category}, first day? Mamma mia. Hold on, I'm gonna knock on your glass.
meltdownReal.classic: {amount} on {category}? On DAY ONE? Madonna santa. Stay right there.
meltdownReal.unhinged: {amount} on {category} on day one? Vaffanculo. Come here.
